passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion contains forward-looking statements, including, without limitation, our expectations and statements regarding our outlook and future revenues, expenses, results of operations, liquidity, plans, strategies and management objectives and any assumptions underlying any of the foregoing. Our actual results may differ significantly from those projected in the forward-looking statements. Our forward-looking statements and factors that might cause future actual results to differ materially from our recent results or those projected in the forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, those discussed in the section titled “Forward-Looking Information” and “Risk Factors” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Except as required by law, we assume no obligation to update the forward-looking statements or our risk factors for any reason. The following section generally discusses fiscal 2026 and 2025 items and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal 2026 and 2025, as well as certain fiscal 2024 items. Discussions of fiscal 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal 2025 and 2024 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2025. Overview Salesforce is a global leader in customer relationship management (“CRM”) technology, helping organizations of any size become agentic enterprises. Founded in 1999, we bring humans, agents, apps, and data together on a trusted, unified platform to unlock growth and innovation. Our platform unites sales, service, marketing, commerce and IT teams by connecting customer data across systems, apps and devices to create a complete view of customers. With this single source of customer truth and integrated artificial intelligence (“AI”), teams can be more responsive, productive and efficient, deliver intelligent, personalized experiences across every channel and increase productivity. During the third quarter of fiscal 2025, we introduced Agentforce, a new layer of our trusted platform that enables companies to build and deploy AI agents that can respond to inputs, make decisions and take action autonomously across business functions. Agentforce includes a suite of customizable agents for use across sales, service, marketing and commerce. We continue to invest for growth, including investing in generative and agentic AI across all products, which we believe will change how our customers help their customers, and continuously look to expand our leadership role in the cloud computing industry. We continue to focus on several key growth levers, including driving multiple service offering adoption, increasing our penetration with enterprise and international customers and expanding our industry-specific reach with more vertical software solutions. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: In evaluating our business, you should carefully consider the following discussion of material risks, events and uncertainties that make an investment in us speculative or risky in addition to the other information included in this Annual Report. A manifestation of any of the following risks and uncertainties could, in circumstances we may or may not be able to accurately predict, materially and adversely affect our business and operations, growth, reputation, prospects, operating and financial results, financial condition, cash flows, liquidity and stock price. Some of the factors, events and contingencies discussed below may have occurred in the past, but the disclosures below are not representations as to whether or not the factors, events or contingencies have occurred in the past and instead reflect our beliefs and opinions as to the factors, events or contingencies that could materially and adversely affect us in the future. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Other events, factors or uncertainties that we do not currently anticipate or that we currently deem immaterial also may affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, other key metrics and the trading price of our common stock. Therefore, you should not consider the following risks to be a complete statement of all the potential risks or uncertainties that we face. credit_strengths.text: Salesforce's operating cash flow covers debt service many times over, with free cash flow roughly matching total debt. This cash generation reflects a recurring subscription model and disciplined cost control, and it comfortably exceeds the sector median cash-flow-to-debt ratio, supporting a minimal indicative financial risk profile.

Operating margins sit above the software sector median, and interest coverage is exceptionally high, indicating ample capacity to absorb rate or earnings shocks. Net leverage, after netting cash and short-term investments, is below the sector median, reinforcing a conservative balance sheet relative to peers.

key_risks.text: The risk-factor passage highlights customer attrition and difficulty predicting subscription renewals and upgrade rates as material operational risks. For a subscription-heavy issuer, renewal softness would pressure revenue and cash flow, potentially eroding the currently strong debt-service coverage and leverage headroom.

Debt maturities concentrate in the next twelve months and year three, with a large balloon after year five. Refinancing this profile depends on continued market access; a funding disruption could strain liquidity, especially given the current ratio below one and sizeable near-term maturities.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is far above the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is near parity, indicating strong capacity to service obligations from internally generated funds. Even a substantial EBITDA decline would leave leverage below the next threshold, providing meaningful headroom.

Cash on hand plus annual operating cash flow comfortably exceeds the near-term maturity, but shareholder distributions and acquisitions absorb most free cash flow. This limits absolute debt reduction and means refinancing remains part of the funding plan, though market access appears strong.

overall_credit_view.text: Salesforce presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with leverage and cash-flow metrics well inside the strongest tier and comfortably better than sector medians. The recurring revenue base and high margins support stable debt service, and threshold headroom is substantial.

Analyst judgement: the credit outlook is stable, supported by strong cash generation and a net cash position after short-term investments. Key monitorables are renewal rates, the pace of buybacks and acquisitions, and the upcoming maturity wall, which could modestly increase leverage if funded with debt.

credit_strengths.text: Salesforce的營運現金流足以覆蓋債務償付多倍，自由現金流與總債務大致相若。此現金產生能力反映經常性訂閱模式及嚴謹的成本控制，並穩健地超越行業中位數的現金流對債務比率，支持極低的指示性財務風險狀況。
營運利潤率處於軟件行業中位數之上，利息覆蓋率異常高，顯示有充裕能力吸收利率或盈利衝擊。在扣除現金及短期投資後，淨槓桿低於行業中位數，相對於同業而言，鞏固了保守的資產負債表。

key_risks.text: 風險因素章節強調客戶流失以及難以預測訂閱續約及升級率為重大營運風險。對於以訂閱為重的發行人而言，續約疲弱將對收入及現金流構成壓力，可能侵蝕目前強勁的債務償付覆蓋率及槓桿緩衝空間。
債務到期集中於未來十二個月及第三年，並在第五年後有大量氣球式還款。為此債務狀況再融資取決於持續的市場准入；融資中斷可能令流動性受壓，尤其考慮到流動比率低於一及近期到期規模可觀。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，自由現金流對債務比率接近持平，顯示從內部產生資金償付責任的能力強勁。即使EBITDA大幅下降，槓桿仍將低於下一門檻，提供有意義的緩衝空間。
手頭現金加上年度營運現金流穩健地超過近期到期債務，但股東分派及收購吸收大部分自由現金流。這限制了絕對債務削減，並意味再融資仍是融資計劃的一部分，儘管市場准入似乎強勁。

overall_credit_view.text: Salesforce呈現極低的指示性財務風險狀況，槓桿及現金流指標遠處於最強級別之內，並穩健地優於行業中位數。經常性收入基礎及高利潤率支持穩定的債務償付，而門檻緩衝空間充裕。
分析師判斷：信貸展望穩定，受強勁現金產生及扣除短期投資後的淨現金狀況支持。主要監察事項為續約率、回購及收購步伐，以及即將到期的債務牆，若以債務融資，可能適度增加槓桿。
